proof_review: Structural total-value identity requires no workout cost/other claims; the lab cost intervention explicitly reconciles claims plus destroyed resources to gross asset value.
Convexity transfer assumes the conditional mean is preserved under Q, and strictness requires positive mass across the face threshold.
Exponential survival proof is for differentiable deterministic hazard, no initial atom and positive survival; it is not stated as a stochastic-intensity factorization.
Discrete and continuous recovery use mutually exclusive first-default events and exact settlement contracts; all remaining claims terminate.
Recovery-market-value adjusted discount rate is derived only under its own constant-coefficient contract, not asserted for recovery of par.
Migration powers require time-homogeneous Markov specification; different P/Q supports are rejected and exhausted survivor conditionals are undefined.

Frechet inequalities are necessary and sufficient for the four two-name cells; indicator correlation needs nonzero marginal variances; pairwise correlation does not determine a general large-portfolio law.
A nonreplicable/frictional liquidity premise is explicit, avoiding two executable unrestricted prices for the same dated payoff.
Full recovery of par at default accelerates cash and can create a negative promised spread relative to a maturity-only zero; no equality-of-payoffs arbitrage is alleged.

resolved_findings.issue: A valid exact default probability extremely close to one rounded to float one before log1p and caused a domain error.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use log1p for probabilities at most one half and log of exact positive survival otherwise; preserves tiny-hazard accuracy and baseline output. Added an independently calculated finite-intensity/repricing boundary check.

resolved_findings.issue: Three conditional empty probability sums returned integer zero rather than the documented exact rational string.
resolved_findings.resolution: Initialize the two structural default sums and joint loss-tail sum with Fraction(0); add three explicit output-type checks. Baseline output unchanged.
